claim: A session's permissions are the intersection of the identity-based policies of the user or role that created the session and the session policies, and permissions can also come from a resource-based policy; a session policy cannot grant more permissions than the identity-based policy of the role being assumed allows, and an explicit deny in any of these policies overrides the allow.

evidence.quote: The permissions for a session are the intersection of the identity-based policies for the IAM entity (user or role) used to create the session and the session policies. Permissions can also come from a resource-based policy. An explicit deny in any of these policies overrides the allow.
You cannot use session policies to grant more permissions than those allowed by the identity-based policy of the role that is being assumed.
